name: n8n Webhook trigger
description: Inbound webhook trigger that starts an n8n workflow; the workflow's downstream actions determine the real side effects.

provenance.notes: Supports version 2.43.7 (npm latest, published 2026-10-16); package license field 'SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.md'.

Supports Webhook node authentication options None, Basic auth, Header auth, JWT auth (api_key represents Header auth; Basic and JWT have no v1 enum value), IP allowlist, test vs production URLs, 16MB max payload.
Sustainable Use License 1.0 plus enterprise .ee files; not an SPDX license, so no license block.
Cloud billing unit is monthly workflow executions (EUR); billing_class left unknown because self-hosted and cloud differ.
